name: URY admin Reports home
describe: Reports landing screen at 1440x900 inside the admin shell with the Reports group open: the four reportsRegistry groups (Sales Summary 8, Customers & Items 5, Employees & Operations 4, Financial 1) as sections of link cards with the registry icons.

Shown when no report is chosen (the live route redirects to Today's Sales). Arabic comes from ury/translations/ar.csv; "Amount", the item, group, branch and breakup names and the sample dates are translated here because ar.csv has no usable entry. "# Orders" and "% of Total" are hard-coded English in the source and stay English. Header cells follow data-table.tsx (12px/500 text-tertiary).
